info.title: Crime and arrests by county and state: violent and property crime, DUI and drug arrests (FBI): data API
info.summary: Static, read-only JSON and CSV files. No key, no sign-up. CORS open.
info.description:
Crime and arrests by county and state: violent and property crime, DUI and drug arrests (FBI): What police agencies reported to the FBI over the last five complete calendar years, for every state and for 2,981 counties, home to 96.5% of U.S. residents: violent crimes, property crimes, arrests for driving under the influence, all arrests, and, for states, arrests for drug abuse violations. County rows add up the agencies the FBI places in each county (a city police department, a sheriff's office, a campus force; an agency that serves several counties counts in the county of its headquarters); a row says how many agencies there are and what share of the county's residents they cover, because a month an agency did not report is counted as not reported, never as zero, and a year in which no agency of the county reported is not published. Rates are per 100,000 residents of the agencies that did report. State rows are the FBI's own state series; the county rows add up the agency-level answers, which can come to less than the state series where the FBI's state count includes reports its agency-level answers do not return. The United States row is the sum of the states. Only counts are published: no officer, victim, suspect or agency name.

Probative is a marketing firm, not a law firm; not legal advice. Every JSON response starts with a "meta" object holding the credit line, citation, DOI and license (CC BY 4.0).
